courier.$comment: Street-courier (livreur) flipbook. OUTCOME after the art gates: the RIDER layer is the shipped sprite — a complete cyclist (FLUX base, frame 1) whose 6 frames get rotating wheel spokes stamped by scripts/retouch-courier-spokes.mjs; the BIKE layer passed its gate but was retired from the composite (art kept as spare, its mesh only serves the pre-art fallback) — see src/render/scene/CourierSprite.tsx. Single source of truth for scripts/gen-courier-sprites.mjs. PER-FRAME GENERATION (ADR 0017, amended — the strip-and-slice strategy was retired after two CI iterations cut subjects across cells): each frames[i] is a NON-EMPTY pose clause and becomes ONE dedicated FLUX image (opening + prompt + clause + style) under the layer's single pinned seed, so the whole subject appears in every image and only the described delta moves. Each PNG is chroma-keyed per file (cutout-enemies.mjs cutout()). No protected committed frame 1 — if ANY frame file of a layer is missing (or FORCE=1), ALL its frames regenerate together (shared-seed consistency makes the layer atomic). Files: public/assets/courier/<layer>.png + <layer>_f<N>.png (frame 1 unsuffixed). scale/offsetY are render-side registration knobs tuned at the art gate; z-order (bike under rider) is fixed in code. Sequencing (Bertrand): the BIKE layer is validated first (only the wheels turn, the whole bike visible in every frame); the RIDER layer follows once the bike passes the art gate. The rider is described POSITIVELY (art bible §3: never negate — never write 'without bike'). fps is tuned so the stamped spokes match the road speed: wheel ≈ 84px of the 256px cell ⇒ ~0.85 world units diameter (COURIER_H 2.6), so at COURIER_SPEED 7 u/s the wheel turns ~2.6 rev/s ≈ 940 deg/s; at the rider layer's 20-deg step that is ~47 frames/s, rounded to 48 (exactly 8 six-frame spoke cycles per second); the spare bike layer's 40-deg step would need ~24 fps if ever re-composited.

boss.$comment: QTE boss figures — 'le Commandant', capstone antagonist of the cinematic boss QTE (story-boss-encounter-qte; fiction docs/game-design/spec-boss-encounter-fiction.md §2; mechanic states docs/game-design/spec-boss-qte-encounter.md §OQ2). Like the `hostages` block (ADR-0030), this is a QTE-ONLY figure family that lives BESIDE `enemies` and is deliberately NOT in `enemies.types`: levelArt.consistency.test.ts forbids any enemies.types key that is not an ARCHETYPES-derived base filename, and the Commandant is a plein-pied authority figure that appears only in the frozen QTE tableau, never popping from windows. He is the chef of the BAC de nuit (PROJECT_GUIDELINES §7 roster extension), NOT a reskin of the CRS `enemy_riot`: distinct commanding silhouette (long knee-length overcoat, bare-headed plainclothes-BAC register per lead-art RULING 2026-07-20, reflective armband brassard + shoulder-clipped radio as the plainclothes authority tells, no helmet/visor/shield/armor), the ONLY uncovered head in an otherwise capped/helmeted roster, readable as 'chef' in <0.3s without colour. Four poses map the core QTE states: shielded (SHIELDED/protégé), exposed (EXPOSED phase-1 single-ring/opens fire), hit (touché), down (à terre/defeated). The differentiation-pack poses (weakpoint = phase-2+ two-ring clean-band frontal, parry_windup = charged/parry tell, finisher = kneeling still-trying coup-de-grâce) and the two Niveau-Final hall props (lustre, speaker_wall) are STRUCTURED below (ADR-0053 D6, ratified prompts from docs/art-direction/prompt-drafts/boss-commander.md, lead-art PROMPT GATE family PASS, 2026-07-20): keys/`asset` paths/pinned seeds landed; the two props each carry a per-type `size` override ([S13] — figures stay the block's square 256x256, `lustre` is portrait 320x512, `speaker_wall` is landscape 512x320, mirroring the `nearForegroundArt.types` per-kind-size precedent). STRUCTURE IS PROVISIONAL, owned by dev-tooling-assets: block name, keys, `asset` paths, `size`, pinned seeds are scaffolding mirrored from `hostages` to carry the prompts — dev-tooling-assets ratifies/wires them with the tech plan (a gen-boss-sprites.mjs does not exist yet for ANY of the 9 boss entries — generation dispatch is separately gated, see below). concept-artist owns ONLY the `prompt` + `style` strings. ANCHOR SCHEMA GAP (flagged, not resolved here — needs senior-architect sign-off before render-integration): the tech plan names render-side anchors for 3 of the 5 new entries (`muzzle` semantics reused conceptually on `commander_weakpoint`'s VITAL/LIMB bands, `parryPoint` on `commander_parry_windup`). The only anchor mechanism this file has today is `enemies.*.muzzle`, a per-FRAME array keyed to a flipbook's `frames.length` — it does not fit these single-image boss entries (no `frames` array) nor a band range (VITAL/LIMB are bands, not points). Rather than invent a new anchor schema unilaterally, no anchor field is added; per-entry $comment flags carry the requirement forward. These values can only be tuned against the real generated PNGs in any case (same as `enemies.*.muzzle`, measured post-generation by scripts/measure-muzzle-anchors.mjs), and generation has not been dispatched. `style` is copied VERBATIM from the live roster (enemies.style/hostages.style) for Family consistency (art-direction.md §2 law 2): the boss migrates to the gated pochoir direction IN LOCKSTEP with the whole roster when lead-art ships that migration (currently blocked on keying), never forked alone. Committed PNGs may be absent until generated in CI. lead-art PROMPT GATE required before any commit/generation.

nearForegroundArt.$comment: Generated near-foreground décor prop sprites (ADR-0049, amends ADR-0047 code-drawn → generated-with-procedural-fallback). Single source of truth for scripts/gen-nearfg-sprites.mjs. House style: strict GREY B&W photocopied-fanzine décor (art law C1 — décor is grey; ZERO colour). gptimage-large on flat magenta #FF3CDC chroma ground, chroma-keyed + luma-desaturated. Files: public/assets/nearfg/<kind>.png. World sizing (aspect/heightFrac, plane math) stays in code (src/render/scene/nearForegroundArt.ts NEAR_KIND_SPECS) so placement + tests do not move; this block carries ONLY generation inputs + render registration knobs. Per-type `size` sets the GENERATED texture pixel dims (width = round(512*aspect)); it must match NEAR_KIND_SPECS aspect (pinned by nearForegroundArt.consistency test) so the plane never distorts. The trafficLight PNG is a DEAD-lens grey housing; the coloured lit lens + halo is a render-side overlay (the one directed C1 exception) anchored via `lenses` (normalized [0..1] over the texture, y-down, TUNED at the art gate against the real PNG — pattern: enemies muzzle anchors). Missing/uncommitted PNG ⇒ render falls back to the procedural CanvasTexture, so the loading gate never breaks. PROMPTS are the LEAD-ART-GATE-FINAL strings from docs/art/prompts-road-props.md § "Lead-art gate" (Nico, 2026-07-19 — verdict 8/8 PASS), copied verbatim: opening/style/per-kind subject clauses + seeds + the trafficLight lenses sketch (lenses stay the tech-plan Decision-1 placeholder values — tuned render-side at the Gate-4 composite review, not a prompt matter). scooter drops the top-box (open-item #1: distinct from the interactive moto's signature silhouette); streetSign keeps the post-mounted plate (open-item #2). STILL OWED before CI dispatch: the asset gate on the keyed PNGs and the composite gate on the trafficLight lit-lens overlay (neither covered by the prompt-gate PASS) — see that doc's "Notes for the generation lane".
